\section{The bound}\label{sec:bound}
\begin{definition}[Graph]\label{def:graph}
Let $G$ have two vertices.
\end{definition}
\begin{theorem}[Energy]\label{thm:energy}
For $x,y\in\mathbb{R}$, $(x-y)^2\geq0$.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
The square in equation~\eqref{eq:energy} is nonnegative.\qed
\end{proof}
\begin{equation}\label{eq:energy}E(x,y)=(x-y)^2.\end{equation}
